name: Petra, the Rose City
desc: A Nabataean city carved into rock, one of the New Seven Wonders.

name: Wadi Rum
desc: Red sand and granite mountains. Spend a night in a Bedouin camp.

name: Jerash
desc: A well-preserved Roman city with colonnaded streets and theatres.

name: Dead Sea
desc: The lowest point on Earth, with buoyant salt water and mineral mud.

name: Wadi Mujib
desc: Water trails through a canyon, a refreshing adventure.

name: Ajloun Castle
desc: An Islamic-era castle overlooking northern forests.

name: Aqaba
desc: Diving and coral reefs on the Red Sea.

name: Madaba
desc: The mosaic city, home to the Holy Land map.

name: Amman Citadel
desc: Roman and Umayyad ruins overlooking downtown.

name: Little Petra
desc: A quiet Nabataean site near Petra, ideal for exploring.

name: Jordanian lunch in Um Sayhoun
desc: Mansaf and local dishes in a village near Petra.

name: Ajloun Forest Reserve
desc: A nature reserve of green hills covered in oak trees, with hiking trails and wooden cabins to stay in.

name: Umm Qais
desc: A Roman-era archaeological city (ancient Gadara) overlooking the Sea of Galilee and the Golan Heights, built from black basalt stone.

name: Pella / Tabaqat Fahl
desc: An important archaeological site with remains from the Stone Age, Bronze Age, Roman and early Islamic periods.

name: Umm al-Jimal
desc: A Nabataean, Roman and Byzantine archaeological town built entirely of black basalt, with churches and ancient water systems.

name: Mount Nebo
desc: An important religious and historic site overlooking Palestine and the Dead Sea, believed to be where Moses looked out over the Holy Land.

name: Baptism Site / Al-Maghtas
desc: A World Heritage archaeological and religious site, believed to be where Jesus was baptized by John the Baptist.

name: Dana Biosphere Reserve
desc: Jordan's largest nature reserve, with rich biodiversity, several geographic zones and long hiking trails.

name: Feynan
desc: An area in Dana Reserve known for the Feynan Eco-Lodge and ancient copper mines.

name: Karak Castle
desc: A huge Crusader and Islamic castle on a high hilltop, with underground passages and tunnels.

name: Shobak Castle
desc: A historic castle from the Crusader (Montreal) and Mamluk eras, on a commanding hill, known for its towers and water tunnels.

name: Mukawir
desc: A historic fortress on a mountain overlooking the Dead Sea, linked to the story of the imprisonment and beheading of John the Baptist.

name: As-Salt Historic City
desc: A World Heritage historic city, known for its Ottoman-era yellow stone houses, heritage architecture and spirit of hospitality.

name: Roman Theatre, Amman
desc: A large Roman theatre from the 2nd century AD in the heart of Amman, seating around 6,000 spectators.

name: Downtown Amman
desc: The historic and commercial center of Amman, with old markets, popular restaurants and heritage landmarks.

name: Royal Automobile Museum
desc: A museum telling the story of modern Jordan through a rare collection of royal cars and motorcycles since the time of King Abdullah I.

name: Iraq Al-Amir
desc: A historic town west of Amman with the Hellenistic-era Qasr al-Abd and natural and archaeological caves.

name: Qasr Amra
desc: An Umayyad desert palace on the UNESCO list, famous for the unique wall paintings inside.

name: Azraq Castle
desc: An archaeological castle of black basalt used through Roman and Umayyad times, where Lawrence of Arabia stayed during the Great Arab Revolt.

name: Azraq Wetland Reserve
desc: A natural oasis in the eastern desert and an important stop for migratory birds, with wooden walkways for exploring.

name: Shawmari Wildlife Reserve
desc: Jordan's first wildlife restoration reserve, known for breeding the Arabian oryx and rim gazelles.

name: Aqaba Marine Park
desc: A marine reserve with dedicated areas for diving and snorkeling to see coral reefs and marine life.
